content.label:
I’ve hosted plenty of parties and used digital invitations many times. Paperless Post has been the worst experience I’ve had with an invitation platform.

I paid for the service because I wanted a beautiful digital presentation to deliver original invitations with the traditional envelope experience. The design delivery was lovely. Everything after that has been unnecessarily frustrating.

Finding invitation links, resending invitations, and helping guests locate their original invitations should be SIMPLE. Instead, the interface turns basic event management into an exercise in patience.

I’m comfortable navigating complicated digital systems. This isn’t a matter of learning how to use technology. It’s poor user-interface design.

For a paid platform, that’s unacceptable.

My advice? Don’t confuse beautiful presentation with a well-designed service. Paperless Post may deliver the former, but in my experience, it falls remarkably short on the latter.
